NBA DFS Picks for Wednesday, October 28 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Wednesday, October 28 · 9 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 28, 7:44 PM ET

Nikola Jokic (DEN) is the top-projected player on the Wednesday, October 28 DraftKings main slate at 64.0 DraftKings points for $12,000. Giannis Antetokounmpo (MIA, 57.2, $10,200) and Jalen Johnson (ATL, 51.3, $9,500) are next.

Clint Capela (HOU) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 7.00 projected points per $1,000 at $3,100.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 28, 7:44 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
